literal_meaning: ঠোঁটগুলো বন্ধ করে রাখা (lips closed keep)
figurative_meaning_en: To remain silent or keep quiet
example_sentences_in_bangla: রহস্য জানলে ঠোঁট বন্ধ রাখো, কাউকে বলো না।
সভায় বিতর্ক চলছে, তুমি ঠোঁট বন্ধ রেখে শোনো।
example_sentences_in_english: If you know the secret, keep your lips sealed and don't tell anyone.
The debate is ongoing in the meeting; keep your lips sealed and just listen.
note: This idiom emphasizes the cultural value of discretion in Bengali society, often used in contexts of wisdom and prudence.
